slides.title: Infinitive of purpose
slides.subtitle: Infinitivo de propósito: para…
goals: Explicar **para qué** haces algo con **to + verbo**.

slides.title: Para = to
body: Para explicar el propósito se usa **to + verbo**. Con sustantivo se usa **for**.

head: Estructura
Ejemplo
rows: I went to the store **to buy** milk.
I went to the store **for** milk.
Why do you study English? — **To get** a better job.

errors.bad: I came for to see you.

items.en: I use my phone to take photos.
items.es: Uso mi celular para tomar fotos.

items.en: She saved money to buy a laptop.
We went to the park for a walk.
items.es: Fuimos al parque a dar un paseo.

items.q: I went to the shop ___ some bread.
I went to the shop ___ buy bread.
Why are you saving money? — ___ travel.
